Source: github.com/memononen/nanosvg, master at 239e102ec2c691f2902e20ace2ed36ee4a35cfe6 (2026-07-09).
Vendored from src/nanosvg.h (unmodified) and src/nanosvgrast.h (altered: nsvg__fixToInt in nsvg__addActive clamps
the fixed-point edge values, whose float to int conversion overflowed on near-flat edges). Used by src/app/icons/ to rasterise the
interface icons (assets/icons/ui/*.svg) into a texture atlas.
